Owen Park: Quick follow-up from PM — we grouped the recurring deploy-time flaps into an "action bucket". Need owners, JIRA links, and one accountable owner per bucket. Keep items < 5d.
Lina Morales: I'll take bucket A (cache + deploy ordering). Will open tickets and add a short mini-RCA in the ticket. ETA +4 days.
Ravi Singh: I'll own bucket B (routing backpressure + circuit logic). Will create RED-55551 and RED-55552 now and tag @Lina for review.
qa-bot: Note: regression suite triggered 3 failures in last two runs. Suggest adding a targeted test for the deploy window.
Owen Park: Please include a rollback-play and a short verification step in each ticket. Also add an "owner rotation" field if single person will hand off after 1 week.
Lina Morales: Created RED-55560 (cache-deploy ordering) -> https://jira.redwood/RED-55560. R=Lina, A=Lina, C=Ravi, I=QA
Ravi Singh: Created RED-55551 (routing backpressure) -> https://jira.redwood/RED-55551 and RED-55552 (circuit logic) -> https://jira.redwood/RED-55552. R=Ravi, A=Ravi, C=Lina, I=Platform
Owen Park: RACI check looks good. Proposed timelines:
- RED-55560 due +4 days (Lina)
- RED-55551 due +3 days (Ravi)
- RED-55552 due +5 days (Ravi)
Lina Morales: I'll add acceptance criteria to RED-55560: 
- Repro in staging with deploy order swap
- Automated check added to deploy pipeline
